mandala_upgraded_temple_holding_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { exists = scope:character }
			exists = county.holder
			county.holder = { is_alive = yes }
		}
		county.holder = { save_scope_as = character }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:character scope:character = { is_alive = yes } }
		scope:character = {
			#Liege paid for the holding
			if = {
				limit = {
					root.county.holder = { is_independent_ruler = no }
					this = scope:character
					government_has_flag = government_is_mandala
				}
				if = {
					limit = { is_alive = yes }
					mqa_b_reward_payment_begin_effect = yes
					add_piety = {
						value = medium_piety_value
						multiply = 1.5
					}
					debug_log = "MQA_REWARD PAYMENT mandala_upgraded_temple_holding_effect allocation=1"
					mqa_b_reward_payment_end_effect = yes
				}
				else = { debug_log = "MQA_REWARD SKIPPED dead_recipient mandala_upgraded_temple_holding_effect allocation=1" }
				root.county.holder = {
					if = {
						limit = { government_has_flag = government_is_mandala }
					}
					if = {
						limit = { is_alive = yes }
						mqa_b_reward_payment_begin_effect = yes
						add_piety = {
							value = minor_piety_value
							multiply = 1.5
						}
						debug_log = "MQA_REWARD PAYMENT mandala_upgraded_temple_holding_effect allocation=2"
						mqa_b_reward_payment_end_effect = yes
					}
					else = { debug_log = "MQA_REWARD SKIPPED dead_recipient mandala_upgraded_temple_holding_effect allocation=2" }
				}
			}
			#Vassal paid for the holding
			else_if = {
				limit = { government_has_flag = government_is_mandala }
				if = {
					limit = { is_alive = yes }
					mqa_b_reward_payment_begin_effect = yes
					add_piety = {
						value = medium_piety_value
						multiply = 1.5
					}
					debug_log = "MQA_REWARD PAYMENT mandala_upgraded_temple_holding_effect allocation=3"
					mqa_b_reward_payment_end_effect = yes
				}
				else = { debug_log = "MQA_REWARD SKIPPED dead_recipient mandala_upgraded_temple_holding_effect allocation=3" }
			}
		}
	}
	else = { debug_log = "MQA_REWARD SKIPPED no_living_builder mandala_upgraded_temple_holding_effect" }
}

creator_mandala_upgraded_regular_holding_piety_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { exists = scope:character }
			exists = county.holder
			county.holder = { is_alive = yes }
		}
		county.holder = { save_scope_as = character }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:character scope:character = { is_alive = yes } }
		scope:character = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					government_has_flag = government_is_mandala
					house ?= { has_house_aspiration_parameter = aspect_of_creation }
					is_house_head = yes

					limit = { is_alive = yes }
